AUFK.description: Internal order master data (SAP CO). Tracks costs, revenues, or activities for projects, maintenance orders, marketing campaigns. Primary key: aufnr.
AUFK.business_meaning: Internal orders for project cost tracking, maintenance, marketing, internal cost collection. objnr links to COEP/COSP for actual/planned costs.
example_questions: Show internal orders by profit center
Which profit center has the most orders?
AUFK.sql_hints: AUFK: use aufnr (order number), ktext (description), prctr (profit center), kostl (cost center), objnr to join COEP/COSP for costs. Group by prctr, kostl, bukrs, or EXTRACT(YEAR FROM erdat) for time analysis.

BSAD.description: Customer cleared items (Accounts Receivable). Paid/cleared customer invoice line items. BSAD = historical cleared receivables (invoice was paid).
BSAD.business_meaning: Cleared (paid) customer invoices. Use for: total payments by customer, revenue collected, payment timing, cash discounts. Join KNA1 on kunnr for customer name.
BSAD.sql_hints: BSAD: dmbtr/wrbtr = amount; augdt = clearing date; kunnr = customer. SUM(dmbtr) GROUP BY kunnr for revenue by customer; GROUP BY prctr, kostl, bukrs; EXTRACT(YEAR FROM augdt) for time. Join KNA1 on kunnr for name1.

BSEG.description: Accounting document segment (FI line items). Every financial transaction creates entries. Customer (koart D), vendor (K), GL (S), material (M), asset (A).
BSEG.business_meaning: All accounting line items. koart: D=customer, K=vendor, S=GL, M=material, A=asset. Use for GL analysis, vendor spend (WHERE koart='K'), customer revenue (WHERE koart='D'), cost by cost center/profit center.
BSEG.sql_hints: BSEG: dmbtr/wrbtr = amount. Filter koart = 'K' for vendor, 'D' for customer. SUM(dmbtr) GROUP BY hkont (GL), kunnr, lifnr, kostl, prctr, aufnr, matnr, vbeln. Join KNA1 on kunnr, LFA1 on lifnr for names.
